verses.text: A person who keeps to themselves only cares about what they want. They reject all good advice.
A fool does not enjoy understanding. He only enjoys giving his own opinions.
When evil comes, contempt comes with it. Shame brings disgrace.
A person's words can be like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing stream.
It is not good to favour the wicked or to keep innocent people from getting justice.
A fool's words lead to arguments. His mouth asks for a beating.
A fool's mouth destroys him. His words are a trap for his own life.
The words of a gossip are like tasty snacks. They go down deep inside a person.
Whoever is lazy in their work is a brother to someone who destroys things.
The name of the LORD is a strong tower. Good people run to him and are safe.
Rich people think their wealth is a strong city, a wall too high to climb.
Before a fall, a person's heart is proud, but humility comes before honour.
Whoever answers before listening is foolish and shames themselves.
A person's spirit can help them through sickness, but who can bear a crushed spirit?
A heart with understanding gains knowledge. The ears of wise people look for knowledge.
A gift opens doors for the giver and brings them into the presence of important people.
The first person to tell their side of a case seems right, until someone else comes and asks questions.
Throwing lots settles arguments and separates powerful opponents.
A brother who has been hurt is harder to win back than a strong city. Arguments are like the locked gates of a fortress.
People's stomachs are filled by what their mouths say. They are satisfied by the harvest of their lips.
The tongue has the power of life and death. Those who love to talk will eat its fruit.
Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing and receives kindness from the LORD.
Poor people beg for mercy, but rich people answer harshly.
Someone with many companions may come to ruin, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
